title: Turkish Delight Mochi
description: A unique Japanese-inspired dessert using crumbly Turkish Delight and buttery mochi.

ingredients.name: Mochi Flour
ingredients.notes: Available at most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Matcha Powder
ingredients.notes: Optional for a green tea flavor

instructions: Combine Mochi Flour, Water, and Sugar in a saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly until the dough forms a ball.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth.
Add Matcha Powder (if using) and knead for an additional minute.
Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let rest for 30 minutes.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1 cm.
Cut out small squares of dough.
Place a small piece of Turkish Delight in the center of each square.
Fold the dough over the Turkish Delight to form a triangle or square shape.
Press the edges of the dough to seal the mochi.
Serve warm with a drizzle of butter on top.
